articles.summary: Eric Crowley Joins as a Managing Director in San Francisco Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Eric Crowley has joined as a Managing Director in the firm’s Global Technology Group. Based in San Francisco, Mr. Crowley will focus on consumer subscription software, consumer technology and ad-tech sectors for the firm. Mr. Crowley brings more than a decade of investment banking and operating experience advising founders, executives, and investors. At GP Bullhound, he led the firm’s Consumer Technology practice and advised on numerous high-profile MA including the sale of Runna to Strava, Bliss Point to Tinuiti, and Alltrails to Spectrum Equity and capital markets transactions including Flo Health raising from General Atlantic.
